name: Machine Pulldown
cardText:
1
Grip the bar with the palms facing forward, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width.
2
As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar, bring your torso back around 30 degrees while sticking your chest out.
3
Pull the bar down to about chin level or a little lower in a smooth movement whilst squeezing the shoulder blades together.
4
After a second of squeezing, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended.

name: Machine Seated Cable Row
cardText:
1
Sit with your back straight on the machine and grip the handles.
2
Pull the handles back using your arms. Your legs and torso should be at a 90° angle. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Row
cardText:
1
Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles.
2
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
3
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Machine Plate Loaded T Bar Row
cardText:
1
Hinge forward while keeping your back flat.
2
Grab the handles and pull the weight toward your chest.
3
Make sure to fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep. Also make sure to not use momentum.

name: Underhand Pulldown
cardText:
1
Use the Straight Bar attachment. Hold with an underhand grip.
2
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
3
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.

name: Machine Assisted Pull Up
cardText:
1
Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
2
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
3
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Machine Assisted Narrow Pull Up
cardText:
1
Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
2
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
3
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Machine Underhand Row
cardText:
1
Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing up, keeping your back straight.
2
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
3
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Machine Neutral Row
cardText:
1
Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing each other, keeping your back straight.
2
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
3
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Stretcher
cardText:
1
Place your foot on the leg pad for leverage and grab the attachment.
2
Start with your arms extended and your head between your arms.
3
Begin to pull. As you pull, lean backwards until the attachment touches your chest.

name: Machine Chest Supported T Bar Row
cardText:
1
Lay on the chest pad and grab the handles. Lift the bar out of the holding hook.
2
Pull the bar to your chest and then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Pulldown
cardText:
1
Grip the handles with the palms facing down.
2
Sit on the machine and press your knees into the knee pad.
3
Pull the handles until your upper arm is even with your torso, or just behind your torso.
4
Extend until your elbows are fully extended before initiating the next rep.

name: Machine Pullover
cardText:
1
Adjust the seating pad for your height.
2
Place your elbows on the elbow pad. Pull the bar forward until it nearly touches your stomach.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Seal Row
cardText:
1
Lay on the chest after adjusting the height off the bar holding hooks to match your arm length.
2
Remove the bar from the hooks, then initiate the set.
3
Pull the bar straight back, then lower to the start position. Fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
4
Lay on the chest after adjusting the height off the bar holding hooks to match your arm length.
5
Remove the bar from the hooks, then initiate the set.
6
Pull the bar straight back, then lower to the start position. Fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
